description: Drop test on robot R1 (demo): motors off (coast), body released near upright, logged until it reaches the 30 deg stand.
true_model: theta/tau = b0/(s^2 - p^2) (linearized); simulated with the nonlinear wheel + body equations (sin theta), RK4, zero-order-hold torque
sign_convention: theta > 0 when the body leans backward; tau > 0 drives the wheels forward
